summary: Bus-route bend with bush at the kerb, no parking and no pull-off.
reasons: Through road, no cars on bush kerb
No clear ground beside the lane
Houses 8-10 m along the lower half

best_section.where: Stanley Terrace south kerb on the bend, beside the bushland

drivers.seclusion: Bushland on the south side, but houses 19-25 m away on the north; dwellings 8-10 m from 35 m onwards.
drivers.access_and_room: Bush meets the kerb on the bend; no verge or pull-off beyond the lane.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with buses and steady traffic on a bend.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north side near the start, none on the bush side.

sun_shade: Dense bush canopy over the south kerb, shading from the south and overhead.
cannot_judge: Width of verge under the canopy
